caption:
Three names of Allah you can learn today

Allah calls Himself the Creator, the Maker and the Fashioner, and tells us He has the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies Him.

Surah Al-Hashr 59:24

Which of these names will you call on in your dua today?

#namesofallah #asmaulhusna #surahhashr #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
